_readme: All content for The Gremlin Office lives here. Rotate strips by changing 'strips'. Turn eggs on/off with 'active'. Positions are yaw (0-360, 0 = desk wall, 90 = gallery) and pitch (-90..90, 0 = eye level); press D in the office to read yaw/pitch under the cursor. size = [width, height] in wall pixels (one wall = 1024 px).
title: The Gremlin Office

strips.title: The Flyer Relay
strips.alt: Six-panel comic. Bryan needs a flyer by noon; Moth sketches, Pip pitches sticky-note ideas, Vesper approves, Noodle rides an office chair to Dot's print shop, and the crew cheers the finished flyer stack while Grimble juggles three headsets.

strips.title: Moth's Night Out
strips.alt: Comic strip about the gremlins' team outing: karaoke, and Moth drawing everyone, though nobody remembers posing.
strips.prank_note: Noodle hung this one upside down. Again.

strips.title: First Day
strips.alt: Comic strip: the Grateful Gremlins' first day at the office.

card.title: Welcome to the Gremlin Office
card.text:
This is where the Grateful Gremlins work: the friendly AI helpers who keep Eclectic Transformation running. They draft, sort, design and print. Bryan decides. Everyone takes breaks.

Look around. Some things in here want to be found.

card.title: The office clock
card.text:
The clock runs on your time: it's {localtime} where you are.

Nothing in here is due.

card.title: An HR poster
card.text:
"Mistakes are just drafts."

HR-approved. Laminated twice, because Noodle.

card.title: Tucked behind Grimble's monitor
card.text: [Bryan's poem here]

card.title: Grimble's mug
card.text:
It says H₂O on the side.

This is your sign to take a sip of water. We'll wait.

card.title: Tucked behind Noodle's monitor
card.text: [Bryan's poem here]

card.title: Noodle's spreadsheet
card.text:
Forty-one tabs. Every cell is orange. The bottom row says "it's fine!!!"

It is, in fact, fine. Noodle has a system. Nobody else understands the system.

card.title: Noodle's office chair
card.text:
Wheels: five. Brakes: zero. Seatbelt: requested by HR, pending.

Fastest courier route to the print shop in the building.

card.title: "Mona Grimsa" by Moth
card.text:
An original, painted on the back of a pizza box.

One eye is missing. The sticky note on the frame says it's out for lunch, back at 2. Moth insists the smile follows you around the room. Grimble says that's an HR matter.

card.title: Gremlin Diaries: the permanent collection
card.text: The strips on this wall rotate. Want to read all of them, newest first?

card.text:

card.title: Vesper's bookshelf
card.text:
Arranged by feeling instead of alphabet. The cozy ones live at eye level.

A tab on the top shelf reads: "editors are just readers who care out loud."

card.title: A window for one slow breath
card.text:
Look out at the hills for a moment.

Breathe in for 4, hold for 4, out for 6. That's it. That's the whole thing.

card.title: Tucked behind Pip's monitor
card.text: [Bryan's poem here]

card.title: Pip's sticky notes
card.text:
Every sticky note is an idea. Pip has never thrown one away.

Current count: too many to count, which Pip says is exactly the right number.

card.title: The office plant
card.text:
It leans a little toward Pip's desk. Nobody moved it.

There's a sticky note on the pot: "you're growing, proud of you."

Grimble has noticed. Grimble has filed nothing.

card.title: Dot's print shop
card.text:
Today's print run: 400 thank-you cards, for no particular reason.

This one's yours: thank you for stopping by.

card.title: A locked door
card.text:
GREMLINS ONLY (humans welcome).

It's locked today. Someone has slid a note under it that just says "back soon."

card.title: Moth's drafting table
card.text:
Today's sketch: this office, seen from the ceiling.

Moth is painting the next version of this room. Same office, more brushstrokes.

card.title: How to look around
card.text:
Drag (or swipe) to look around. Arrow keys work too, and + / - zoom.

Things that glow when you hover want to be clicked. Lost? The Explore button lists everything you've found.

card.title: A paper airplane
card.text:
Stuck in a ceiling tile. On the wing, in orange crayon: "NOODLE WAS HERE (TUESDAY)".

Nobody knows which Tuesday.

card.title: Grimble, HR lead
card.text: Keeper of the clipboard. Believes every meeting should start with one slow breath. Owns three headsets and answers none of them.
card.alt: Cartoon portrait of Grimble the gremlin

card.title: Noodle, Ops (chaos division)
card.text: Moves fast and breaks almost nothing. Holds the office-chair speed record to the print shop.
card.alt: Cartoon portrait of Noodle the gremlin

card.title: Pip, Idea-hoarder
card.text: Carries a satchel of sticky notes. Every one is an idea. None are allowed in the bin.
card.alt: Cartoon portrait of Pip the gremlin

card.title: Moth, Quiet designer
card.text: Draws everything, says little. Drew the whole team at karaoke. Nobody remembers posing.
card.alt: Cartoon portrait of Moth the gremlin

card.title: Vesper, Editor, raised in a library
card.text: Edits with a purple pen and a kind heart. "On brand!" is the highest praise in the building.
card.alt: Cartoon portrait of Vesper the gremlin

card.title: Dot, Print shop
card.text: If it can be printed, folded or stapled, Dot has already done it twice.
card.alt: Cartoon portrait of Dot the gremlin
